summary: Completed testing of Staff Slot Blocking feature for DiaGyn page. All backend APIs (block-slots, unblock-slots, get-blocked-slots) pass 9/9 tests. Frontend BlockSlotsDialog component works correctly - Block Slots button appears in header when staff is logged in at step 3 with doctor/clinic/date selected. Staff can select multiple slots to block, blocked slots appear as unavailable for patients.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend slot blocking APIs are well-implemented with proper validation (past date check, duplicate check)
Frontend BlockSlotsDialog component has proper data-testid attributes for testing
isStaffLoggedIn() function correctly checks JWT token expiry and role permissions
Blocked slots correctly appear in booked-slots API response (status 'blocked' included in query)
WebSocket broadcast notifies other clients when slots are blocked/unblocked
seed_data_creation: None - test data cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slot blocking feature fully tested and working. Staff can login, navigate to DiaGyn step 3, select doctor/clinic/date, and use Block Slots button to block appointment slots. Blocked slots appear as unavailable for patients. Test file at /app/tests/test_slot_blocking.py covers all backend APIs.
